title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E03 — Mining Dirty
Desperate to run more pay dirt, Todd fires up Big Trommel. The plant is so worn-out that Todd nicknames it 'Hot Mess'. The team chases fix after fix to keep the plant running and chase its million-dollar goal.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E04 — Jack Attack
It's Jack Hoffman's birthday, but if the crew wants to achieve its goal, there's no time for cake; Todd and his crew must solve why the Big Trommel is leaking out more than half the gold in the pay dirt.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E04 — Wild West Gold
Gold is still there for the taking in the heart of America's Wild West; a drought's end in the Black Hills of South Dakota has replenished the gold in its waterways, giving better access to everyday miners for the first time in years.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E03 — Big Dollar Beaches
Dave Turin welcomes viewers into his own backyard -- the state of Oregon; from the Rogue River rapids to the sands of the Pacific coastline, he shows viewers where the gold is and how to get it.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E02 — There's Gold in Them Thar Georgia Hills
The historic Dahlonega Gold Belt is the Deep South's best-kept secret among miners; Dave takes viewers through Georgia and Alabama to showcase everyday miners using backyard ingenuity to find riches.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E06 — Carolina Rare Gold
Dave Turin visits the Carolinas to show America's rarest, most valuable gold; ingenious everyday miners, a moonshiner looking to cash in on a family's claim, and a gold nomad show Dave that the site of America's first rush is still rich with gold.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E11 — Forty Days to Fail or Fortune
A widowed Colorado mine owner and her foreman face a last stand to save her gold-rich, inherited claim; Freddy and Juan scramble with ingenious fixes and point them towards a pay streak before winter closes them out.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E08 — Double Trouble
A familiar miner in Alaska desperately needs 150 ounces of gold to save their operation; when Juan learns that their landowner's mine is halfway to $1M in the hole, he and Gold Rush legend Dave Turin face their first-ever double rescue.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S04 E01 — Valley of Riches
The fate of a rookie mountain miner lies in the balance after he sinks his life savings into a British Columbia placer claim; with fine gold proving tricky to capture, Freddy and Juan must develop all-new ideas to boost recovery.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E03 — Avalanche Country
Competing companies team up to recover a fully loaded cement truck leaking natural gas; Big Jon heads into avalanche country to rescue a stuck semi carrying hazardous goods; during a sudden blizzard, a crash in Salt Lake City leaves a semi in pieces.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E05 — Ain't Worth Dying For
As a record-breaking windstorm hits Wyoming, recovery crews work side by side in hurricane-force winds to right rolled semis and clear the interstate; an icy path around Utah Lake overturns a loaded dump truck.

The Gallery 63 team takes in two chairs that may have come from a New Orleans cat house and a 1969 Oldsmobile 442; a young soldier raising money for his wedding brings in a WWII Japanese rifle and sword.

description:

A research facility spawns new technology with earth-shattering implications; a coastal haven for African Americans changes the nation; a forgotten fortress fights off a Nazi submarine; a staunch building stands firm on San Francisco's darkest day.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E01 — The Cult of Antelope, Oregon
A rural town in Oregon is invaded by an eccentric cult, a battered building in Florida plays a major role in the cigar trade, and a junkyard palace in New Jersey becomes the subject of controversy and rumors of the supernatural.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S04 E06 — Idaho's Atomic Ghost Town
The remains of Idaho's nuclear industry mark a new era of American history; a distillery in rural Kentucky revolutionizes liquor; a New England settlement prospers despite prejudice; subterranean chambers produce many of the nation's monuments.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E07 — Chasing Civil War Gold
Josh hunts for missing Confederate gold, exploring a wagon train robbery site where stolen coins vanished; then, a fresh eyewitness lead points directly to Jefferson Davis's lost war chest.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E04 — America's First Train Robbers
Josh tracks down the legend and treasure of an outlaw posse, who terrorized the Midwest's railroads; Josh tracks the Reno Gang's lost loot to a cave hideout that could hold millions.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S14 E06 — Dive for America's Pirate Loot
Josh braves the frigid, shark-infested waters off Cape Cod to dive the world's only confirmed pirate wreck; joining a high-tech recovery mission, Josh chases the multi-million-dollar treasure of Black Sam Bellamy, including coins, gold and jewels.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E05 — Secrets of Mexico's Underworld
Josh joins archeologists as they bushwhack through thick jungles and rappel into vast caves in search of the lost Zoque culture.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E02 — The Man-Eating Lions of Kenya
Josh braves the African savanna to investigate the rampage of two lions who killed as many as 135 railroad workers in 1898; to prevent more bloodshed, Josh joins wildlife rangers tracking a pair of rogue lions who are on a modern-day killing spree.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E02 — There Will Be Blood
In an international tribes challenge, one survivalist must cope with menstruation in the middle of the African bush.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E01 — Death by Crocodile
A hunter and a farmer pool their knowledge to survive 21 days in South Africa; when the African wildlife proves too stealthy to hunt, the survivalists take a life-threatening risk for food.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E08 — Toxic Redemption
Four survivalists seek redemption for their past failures; however, their promises to make it through 21 days on a remote Philippine lake are put to the test when they accidentally ingest a toxic substance.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E07 — Enter the Queen
"Naked and Afraid" legend Laura Zerra returns to mentor a blacksmith and a former MMA fighter as they attempt to survive 21 days in Yucatán; scant food resources, deadly crocodiles and violent storms shake their confidence.
